name: grid-11
description: Numbered six-step process grid with durations and a nine-week progress strip.

files.content:
const steps = [ { title: "Discovery call", duration: "Week 1", text: "A 90-minute session to map goals, constraints and the people who will sign off." }, { title: "Audit & research", duration: "Weeks 1-2", text: "We review analytics, interview six customers and benchmark three competitors." }, { title: "Direction", duration: "Week 3", text: "Two distinct creative routes presented as working prototypes, not mood boards." }, { title: "Design sprint", duration: "Weeks 4-6", text: "Daily builds in a shared preview link. Feedback lands in hours, not weeks." }, { title: "Build & QA", duration: "Weeks 7-8", text: "Production code, accessibility audit and performance budget checks on every page." }, { title: "Launch & handover", duration: "Week 9", text: "We ship, train your team and stay on call for 30 days after go-live." }, ] export default function Grid11() { return (

How we work

Nine weeks from kickoff to launch.

    {steps.map((step, index) => (
  1. {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")} {step.duration}

    {step.title}

    {step.text}

    2. ))}
{Array.from({ length: 9 }).map((_, week) => (

W{week + 1}

))}
) }
